variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: BLIP-3, also called xGen-MM, is Salesforce AI Research's open framework and model family for building large multimodal models that read images and text in one sequence. It combines a vision encoder, a vision token sampler, and a pretrained language model. The 2024 paper reports 4B and 14B model variants, base and instruction-tuned checkpoints, training recipes, and released datasets.
variants.prompt: Match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Simpler connector
pairs.detail: BLIP-3 replaces BLIP-2's Q-Former with a Perceiver-style vision token sampler designed to scale across image patches.
pairs.explanation: BLIP-3 replaces BLIP-2's Q-Former with a Perceiver-style vision token sampler designed to scale across image patches.

pairs.label: One training objective
pairs.detail: Every stage uses the language model's autoregressive text-token loss instead of combining contrastive, matching, and generation objectives.
pairs.explanation: Every stage uses the language model's autoregressive text-token loss instead of combining contrastive, matching, and generation objectives.

pairs.label: Interleaved inputs
pairs.detail: Images and text can alternate in free form, enabling multi-image questions and multimodal demonstrations.
pairs.explanation: Images and text can alternate in free form, enabling multi-image questions and multimodal demonstrations.

pairs.label: Data is the system
pairs.detail: The framework emphasizes curated captions, OCR, grounding, and interleaved documents rather than architecture alone.
pairs.explanation: The framework emphasizes curated captions, OCR, grounding, and interleaved documents rather than architecture alone.

pairs.label: Align at base resolution
pairs.detail: Train on about 100 billion multimodal tokens at 384 x 384 resolution using caption, OCR, grounding, and interleaved mixtures.
pairs.explanation: Train on about 100 billion multimodal tokens at 384 x 384 resolution using caption, OCR, grounding, and interleaved mixtures.

pairs.label: Recover high-resolution detail
pairs.detail: Add high-resolution and text-rich data with any-resolution sampling, up to 12 detail patches on the long-side grids reported in the paper.
pairs.explanation: Add high-resolution and text-rich data with any-resolution sampling, up to 12 detail patches on the long-side grids reported in the paper.

pairs.label: Teach instruction following
pairs.detail: Fine-tune on a three-million-example mixture for one epoch, including multimodal and pure-text instruction data.
pairs.explanation: Fine-tune on a three-million-example mixture for one epoch, including multimodal and pure-text instruction data.

pairs.label: Restore interleaved behavior
pairs.detail: Mix multi-image examples with a subset of single-image data so multi-image gains do not unnecessarily erase single-image ability.
pairs.explanation: Mix multi-image examples with a subset of single-image data so multi-image gains do not unnecessarily erase single-image ability.
